intended_operation: Replace the source soundtrack with a selected 10-second excerpt of the current song; preserve source image sequence and FPS without generative processing.

compiled_api.reason: No hand conversion from editor JSON. Actual compiled inputs must come from the Comfy server.

input_files.selection_status: opening excerpt for draft preview; no lyric alignment claimed

schema_evidence.review: Public master reviewed through raw source on 2026-10-07; mutable revision, not a pinned Cloud installation.
schema_evidence.observed: LoadVideo uses file. Components supplies images/audio/fps/bit_depth/color_space. CreateVideo takes images, fps and optional audio/bit_depth/color_space/codec. SaveVideo offers dynamic format/codec choices.

schema_evidence.review: Public master reviewed through raw source on 2026-10-07; mutable revision, not a pinned Cloud installation.
schema_evidence.observed: LoadAudio uses audio. TrimAudioDuration uses start_index and duration in seconds. PreviewAudio accepts and outputs AUDIO.

editor_examples.reuse: LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents, CreateVideo and Note editor structure; current public optional widget/schema adjustments.
LoadAudio and SaveVideo editor structure; no SyncLipSyncNode included.

limitations: Native frame assembly decodes and re-encodes video; compressed video stream identity is not retained. The separate local stream-copy preview is a different operation.
No face generation, mouth editing, beat matching, lyric alignment or lip-sync.
PreviewAudio executes only when queued; it is not evidence that the excerpt has been listened to.

Public master schemas may be newer than Cloud. Verify CreateVideo optional widgets, GetVideoComponents output list, SaveVideo dynamic format/codec serialization and LoadAudio upload widgets during authenticated conversion.
MP3 decoding and output audio encoding may introduce codec delay or duration rounding; measure final file and listen before accepting.
Source FPS is connected; 24 in the widget is only a fallback display. No resizing, retiming or interpolation nodes are present.
required_before_run: Upload/select existing source media with the actual returned Cloud filenames.
Import/editor server conversion; inspect actual compiled inputs and dry-run validation.
Check only the intended output branches are active and confirm usage scope before one bounded run.
acceptance_checks: Decoded output: 1280 x 720, 24 fps, 240 frames; no deliberate timing or framing changes.
Only the requested song excerpt is audible; source soundtrack absent.
Measure final audio/video duration and check sync by listening, without claiming mouth alignment.
Keep actual executed graph, output, settings, measured costs and defects with the run record.
